steps.what: Review actual clinical history, assessment findings and current needs in the clinical system in {OTHER}.
Discuss goals, preferences and feasible treatment with the client.
Develop treatment plans using clinical experience and knowledge, selecting goals, interventions and review timing.
Write the plan in the clinical plan form in {OTHER}.
Check the written plan for consistency with actual clinical decisions and agreed goals.
Save the ordinary authored treatment plan in the existing clinical record.
Implement the agreed counseling activities with the client, adapting delivery to actual responses.

tasks.design: Configure stable case headers and blank goal/intervention sections in the clinical plan category of {OTHER}. The counselor develops every substantive plan choice, writes and checks it, then implements the actual counseling activities; no model chooses treatment or issues orders.
tasks.previous_blocker: Clinical plan writing includes a small amount of repeated form setup.
tasks.enabler_now: Native blank-section templates can remove structural typing without copying old clinical judgements.
tasks.still_hard: Clinically suitable goals and feasible interventions must fit the client rather than a template.
tasks.human_edge: Turn clinical knowledge and the client's priorities into a workable therapeutic relationship.
tasks.altitude: A small documentation saving; clinical planning and implementation rights do not change.

evidence.claim: Native plan templates can reuse fixed headers and empty structure without selecting treatment.

assumptions: Boundary includes genuine planning, written care plan and counseling implementation, not medication prescribing, referral or a machine treatment order. No new record beyond the actual care plan is added.

Existing clinical staff produce the actual history and assessment in routine care. S1 counts source reading and identity verification; s2 captures priorities, s3 makes decisions and s4 manually writes all substantive content. No clean structured clinical-decision feed is assumed.

Test native blank-plan structure first. S4's10% cut removes1.5 provisional hours of repeating verified case headers and headings, leaving13.5 for actual plan wording and repair. All judgement, implementation and ordinary save time remain. S5 is an existing factual check, not a self-approval gate.
unknowns: Whether current plan forms already reuse headers
research_questions: Can the native form preserve empty clinical choices without silently copying a prior intervention?

already_counted.description: Clinical source review, client priorities, plan decisions and writing, checks, saving and implementation

incremental.description: Maintain blank plan sections and safe header settings

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B100 R98.5 gives1.5 gross less0.3 upkeep=1.2 net. Low0 retains all plan writing for bespoke narratives with no repeated structure or where native form reuse is already active; no additional upkeep is introduced. Provisional estimates.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Collect client information through interviews, observations and tests

steps.what: Interview clients about background, needs and progress, following up ambiguous information.
Observe actual client presentation and administer any selected clinical questionnaire appropriately.
outputs: Observed information and actual questionnaire responses

steps.what: Capture interview information, observed facts and actual questionnaire responses in the clinical system in {OTHER}.
inputs: Observed information and actual questionnaire responses

steps.what: Confirm the exact questionnaire version, permitted arithmetic key and missing-response rules.
outputs: Verified instrument version and scoring rules

steps.what: Calculate the selected questionnaire's literal score from captured responses in {OTHER}.
inputs: Verified instrument version and scoring rules
outputs: Draft arithmetic score or explicit unscorable result

steps.what: Check recorded meaning and score against actual responses, resolving omissions without inferring missing risk statements.
inputs: Draft arithmetic score or explicit unscorable result
Verified instrument version and scoring rules
outputs: Checked collected information and any verified score

steps.what: Save the ordinary authored assessment information in the actual clinical record.
inputs: Checked collected information and any verified score

tasks.design: Where the counselor actually uses an approved questionnaire and calculates its score manually, configure its exact arithmetic in the clinical system category of {OTHER}. Interviews, observation, response capture, version verification and semantic checking stay human; a score does not diagnose, infer risk or choose treatment.
tasks.previous_blocker: Manual arithmetic can sit beside otherwise essential human information gathering.
tasks.enabler_now: Native exact instrument scoring may remove arithmetic without using a model or interpreting free text.
tasks.still_hard: What a response means and what has not been asked cannot be reduced to a total.
tasks.human_edge: Notice a contradiction or unspoken concern and ask sensitively about it.
tasks.altitude: Less score arithmetic in instrument-based assessments; no additional assessment or treatment authority.

evidence.claim: Exact native questionnaire arithmetic can remove manual scoring while leaving instrument choice, response capture and clinical interpretation human.

assumptions: This is a conditional assessment mix with a real manually scored questionnaire, not a claim every interview uses one. For interviews/observation only, do not create tests or scoring work. Time shares are provisional and require local validation.

Client responses are produced through actual administration in s2 and captured by the counselor in s3. S4 verifies instrument id/version, response scale, reversal key and missing-item rules from the actual manual. No free transcript or machine-inferred responses exist; unsupported versions remain manually scored.

Test native scoring first. Only the existing arithmetic in s5 is removed. S6 retains semantic checks, missing-response clarification and manual repair/recalculation of failed scoring. No inferred suicide, violence or abuse content is added; no automated diagnosis, eligibility or treatment decision occurs. Routine internal saves need no extra gate.
unknowns: Actual use and permitted versions of scored questionnaires
Whether native scoring is already active
research_questions: Does native scoring match independently checked key examples, reversed items and missing-response cases?

already_counted.description: Interview, observation, actual response capture, instrument verification, meaning checks and failed-score repair

incremental.description: Maintain instrument version/key settings and recheck changed versions

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B100 R88 gives12 gross less1 upkeep=11 net for actual manual scoring of supported instruments. Low0 retains all information gathering and manual handling for an unstructured interview or unsupported test key, with no scoring configuration or upkeep. Existing automatic scoring earns none.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Modify treatment approaches as client status changes

steps.what: Assess actual changes in clients' status and their significance for the current approach.
Discuss changes, preferences and immediate feasibility with the client.
Modify treatment activities or approaches using clinical judgement about the changed client status.
Apply the modified activities with the client and observe immediate response.
outputs: Delivered modified activity and actual response

steps.what: Write the actual approach change, reason and response in the existing clinical session note.
inputs: Delivered modified activity and actual response

steps.what: Save the ordinary session-note update in the existing clinical record.

tasks.design: Keep the actual activity change and its existing clinical note human in {OTHER}. Test the current native session form first; where it already supplies headers, a new generator would still need full content capture and semantic checking, so no further time reduction is supported.
tasks.previous_blocker: The changing therapeutic situation, not repeated formatting, determines the work.
tasks.enabler_now: No new capability removes the need to notice, discuss, choose and document the actual change.
tasks.still_hard: A technically plausible activity may damage trust or fail to fit the client's immediate state.
tasks.human_edge: Adapt the interaction while observing the person in front of the counselor.
tasks.altitude: Nothing changes in task time or decision rights under this design.

evidence.claim: Activity adaptation and a short original clinical note still require the counselor's situation-specific observation and wording.

assumptions: Boundary includes the actual approach-change session note used for continuity of care. It does not create an extra treatment-change register, duplicate the initial plan-writing task or introduce a new report/send. Note writing and ordinary saving are split from live work before evaluating savings.

Counselor observation and client conversation in s1-s4 produce the actual reason, activity and response; s5 captures them manually. No transcript, auto-inferred client status or unpriced new source is assumed.

This conservative case already has a native note form with case headers. Template reuse removes no further task work; copying prior clinical content would not produce the actual change. Existing form/save runtime earns no benefit. No new model, approval or workflow is introduced, so incremental upkeep is zero.
unknowns: Whether the actual task includes any additional duplicate entry
research_questions: Is there a real repeated transfer beyond the session note that a separate design could remove?

already_counted.description: Actual assessment, discussion, modification, delivery, clinical note writing and save

incremental.description: No new system or process introduced; no additional ongoing upkeep

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B100 R100 and0 incremental gives0 net. Actual clinical note and save are explicitly retained after testing native forms; there is no established duplicate transfer or new formatting change. A different documented record flow would require its own scoped analysis.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Evaluate counseling effectiveness against client objectives

steps.what: Select actual client objectives, comparable review dates and relevant existing progress evidence.
Discuss actual progress and unresolved problems with the client rather than relying only on scores.
Assemble existing like-for-like objective and outcome measures across review dates in {OTHER}.
Evaluate counseling effectiveness, checking source comparability, missing outcomes and alternative explanations for progress.
outputs: Human evaluation of counseling effectiveness and limits

steps.what: Write the actual clinical review conclusion against the client's defined objectives.
inputs: Human evaluation of counseling effectiveness and limits

steps.what: Save the ordinary clinical progress-review conclusion in the existing case record.

tasks.design: Configure a native same-objective progress view in the clinical case-system category of {OTHER}, showing original measures, dates, versions and missing values. The counselor checks comparability, discusses progress and evaluates effectiveness; the display neither attributes causation nor recommends a clinical decision.
tasks.previous_blocker: Actual outcome values may be manually assembled across dated records before clinical review.
tasks.enabler_now: Native filtered views can assemble existing compatible values without inventing a composite outcome score.
tasks.still_hard: Progress can reflect changed circumstances, missing follow-up or changing goals rather than program effectiveness.
tasks.human_edge: Judge whether apparent improvement represents meaningful progress for this person.

ambition.what: Examine a stalled objective separately from an improving overall symptom measure.

tasks.altitude: Less copying of dated measures; more interpretation of why an objective is or is not being met. No automatic care decision.

reach.task: Describe limits of an outcome comparison
reach.learn: Missingness, changing instruments and causal inference limits

evidence.claim: Native outcome views can assemble existing comparable measures but cannot establish counseling's causal effectiveness.

assumptions: Boundary is the counselor's actual clinical progress review, with its existing review conclusion used in ongoing care. It is not a new management report or a program-wide data collection initiative.

Treating staff and actual client assessments produce case id, objective id, measure/instrument version, date, value and source record in ordinary clinical work; that capture is unchanged and earns no saving. S1 counts selecting and checking actual evidence, s2 collects the current client context, and s4 retains missing data, incompatible-measure interpretation and failed-view manual repair. No newly structured narrative outcomes are supplied free.

Test native views first. S3 is eligible only for actual manual assembly of existing compatible values; unstructured notes stay manual. All interpretation, real conclusion writing and ordinary save work remain fully retained and ungated.
unknowns: Whether comparable objective views already exist
research_questions: Can the native view expose missing values and instrument changes rather than silently combining them?

already_counted.description: Evidence selection, client discussion, comparability and missing-data review, manual repair and actual clinical conclusion

incremental.description: Maintain objective/measure mappings and check altered instrument versions

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B100 R80 gives20 gross less2 upkeep=18 net for actual manual assembly of compatible stored values. Low0 retains all assembly where goals changed, versions are incomparable or progress exists only in narrative notes, and avoids deploying a misleading view or its upkeep.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Use native forms, exact instrument arithmetic and compatible progress views for literal work while retaining clinical judgement, information capture and the therapeutic relationship.
reach: Describe outcome-comparison limits with program-evaluation training
role.ambitious_version: A counselor who can examine an individual stalled objective with clearer evidence, retaining responsibility for assessment and treatment.
